Features

Search & discover — Freesound, YouTube, random finds, and pasted URLs.
16-pad kits — Build, save, and share banks of sounds.
Play it your way — Pads, keyboard mapping, or automatic slicing.
Shape audio — Trim, pitch, stretch, loop, and more.
Resample — Capture an earlier or later moment from a source.
Drag & drop — Move samples straight into your DAW or sampler.
